title: ee.search.score_calibration.v1
description: Workspace-level scaled split-conformal calibration metadata emitted under metadata.scoreCalibration on ee search responses. Pair with ee.search.score_interval.v1, which is the per-result two-number relevance interval that this calibration produces.

method.description: Calibration method identifier; today only scaled_split_conformal is emitted.

status.description: Calibration readiness; controls whether per-result scoreInterval bounds are real or fall back to a heuristic.

coverage.description: Target coverage probability (e.g. 0.95). Constant across emissions; surfaced so consumers do not need a separate config read.

sampleCount.description: Number of residual samples (across jsonl + feedback events) used in this calibration.

minimumSamples.description: Threshold below which status transitions to insufficient.

sourceBreakdown.description: Per-source counts that sum to sampleCount.

feedbackEvents.description: Residual samples derived from stored feedback events.

corruptRowCount.description: Total residual rows discarded as malformed across the JSONL source.

corruptLineNumbers.description: 1-indexed line numbers of malformed JSONL rows, truncated at the registry cap; empty when corruptRowCount is 0.

residualQuantile.description: Empirical residual quantile used to scale per-result interval radii. Null when status != calibrated.

unreadableReason.description: snake_case label of the io::ErrorKind that prevented JSONL parsing. Null for every status other than unreadable. See bd-25z97.
